system.description:
You perform a series of brutal and efficient strikes with your weapon in an attempt to cripple and debilitate the target. Make two melee taijutsu attacks against a creature you can see within range, with your weapon. On a hit you deal your [Weapons damage] + 1d10. If you hit with at least one of your attacks the affected target must success a Strength Saving throw. On a failed save, the target gains a rank of Weakened as you dislocate multiple bones in the targets body.

Chain 1: A creature who fails their saving throw gains an additional rank of Weakened.

Chain 2: Constructs and structures are vulnerable to this jutsu’s damage.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d10.
